rationale: The resource remains connected throughout the voltage sag. The minimum observed voltage is 0.55 pu for about 0.50 s, which is inside the ride-through envelope (above the 0.50 pu minimum for durations up to 0.70 s). Reactive current reaches 0.25 pu at 0.12 s, satisfying the 0.20 pu minimum within the 0.10 s response deadline after the sag begins at 0.05 s, and voltage is no longer below 0.90 pu by 0.55 s.
